_comment: Fixture of F1 before/after each of the thirteen silent F1-destroying bugs.
Values are those claimed in report/sections/bugs.tex; some are measured
(f1_before reproduced by intentionally running with the bug) and some are
'measured' flag distinguishes the two so reviewers know which entries
are empirical and which are mechanistic lower bounds.
F1 values are global (unweighted-mean over the four SROIE fields).
f1_after for every entry is the post-fix pipeline F1 reported in
combined_metrics.json at the head of the repo; we use a placeholder
of 0.74 (the commonly-reported SROIE-500 number) so the figure is
meaningful when run before a full training pass, and overwrite it

bugs.mechanism: Tied-weight dedup drops lm_head; reload retied at wrong dim.
String prompt → ID of '<' not the special token; decoder starts mid-vocab.
Multi-page wrapper; field extraction sees [{...}] not {...}.
fp16 dynamic range insufficient for long-sequence CE loss; NaN training.
Default imgsz=640 scales anchors to wrong resolution; 0% detection.
Val loss ≈ 9.1 at epoch 1; all-empty predictions cascade to assigner.
Inflated val F1 by 10+ points; hides overfitting and misguides early stopping.
ultralytics≥8.3 writes absolute path; FileExistsError aborts training.

load_best_model_at_end restores best checkpoint with stale generation_config (mBART <s> start); eval sees wrong decoder_start_token_id; F1≡0. Guard now symmetric across DONUT and TrOCR trainers, with assertion verified on disk.
resize_token_embeddings no longer auto-resizes lm_head; new tokens untrained.
transformers≥4.48 injects kwarg that SwinModel rejects; first-batch TypeError.
Root tag becomes dict key; every field reads as missing; per-field F1≡0.
Non-zero warmup_steps silently overrides warmup_ratio; schedule mis-applied.
